skills.title: Place value up to millions
skills.scope: Place value and total value of digits up to millions; numbers up to millions in symbols.

skills.title: Read, order and round numbers up to 100,000
skills.scope: Read and write numbers up to 100,000 in words; order them; round to the nearest thousand.

skills.title: Squares and square roots
skills.scope: Squares of whole numbers up to 100; square roots of perfect squares up to 10,000.

skills.title: Multiply 4-digit by 2-digit numbers
skills.scope: Multiply up to a 4-digit number by a 2-digit number; estimate products; multiplication patterns with products not exceeding 1,000.

skills.title: Divide up to 4-digit by 3-digit numbers
skills.scope: Divide up to a 4-digit number by up to a 3-digit number; estimate quotients by rounding to the nearest ten.

skills.title: Combined operations up to 3-digit numbers
skills.scope: Combined operations involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division up to 3-digit numbers.

skills.title: Add and subtract fractions using LCM
skills.scope: Add and subtract fractions using the LCM.

skills.title: Add and subtract mixed numbers
skills.scope: Add and subtract mixed numbers.

skills.title: Reciprocals and squares of fractions
skills.scope: Reciprocal of proper fractions up to a 2-digit number; squares of fractions with a one-digit numerator and a 2-digit denominator.

skills.title: Fractions and percentages
skills.scope: Express a fraction as a percentage; convert a percentage to a fraction.

skills.title: Decimals: ten-thousandths and rounding
skills.scope: Identify decimals up to ten thousandths; round decimals up to 3 decimal places.

skills.title: Decimals, fractions and percentages
skills.scope: Convert between decimals and fractions and between decimals and percentages.

skills.title: Add and subtract decimals (4 places)
skills.scope: Add and subtract decimals up to 4 decimal places.

skills.title: Simple inequalities
skills.scope: Form, simplify and solve simple inequalities in one unknown.

skills.title: Millimetres and centimetres
skills.scope: The millimetre; relate and convert millimetres and centimetres.

skills.title: Operations with centimetres and millimetres
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide lengths in centimetres and millimetres.

skills.title: Circumference and diameter
skills.scope: Measure the circumference of a circle; relate circumference and diameter (pi).

skills.title: Area of triangles and combined shapes
skills.scope: Area of triangles in square centimetres; area of combined shapes of squares, rectangles and triangles.

skills.title: Estimate the area of circles
skills.scope: Estimate the area of circles by counting squares.

skills.title: Cubic centimetres, millilitres and litres
skills.scope: Relate cubic centimetres, millilitres and litres; convert litres and millilitres.

skills.title: Tonnes and kilograms
skills.scope: The tonne as a unit; relate and convert kilograms and tonnes; estimate mass in tonnes.

skills.title: Operations with tonnes and kilograms
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide mass in tonnes and kilograms.

skills.title: 12-hour and 24-hour clocks
skills.scope: Identify and write time in a.m. and p.m.; relate and convert the 12-hour and 24-hour systems.

skills.title: Travel timetables
skills.scope: Interpret travel timetables.

skills.title: Simple budgets
skills.scope: Prepare a simple budget.

skills.title: Prices, profit and loss
skills.scope: Buying and selling prices; work out profit and loss from sales.

skills.title: Types of taxes
skills.scope: Identify types of taxes, including income tax and VAT.

skills.title: Constructing lines
skills.scope: Construct parallel and perpendicular lines; bisect lines by construction.

skills.title: Angles on a straight line
skills.scope: Identify, measure and add angles on a straight line at a point.

skills.title: Angle sums in triangles and rectangles
skills.scope: Sum of angles in rectangles and triangles.

skills.title: Construct and measure triangles
skills.scope: Construct equilateral, right-angled and isosceles triangles; measure their interior angles.

skills.title: Faces, edges, vertices and nets
skills.scope: Vertices, faces and edges of cuboids, cubes and cylinders; plane figures in 3-D objects; nets.

skills.title: Frequency tables, pictographs and piling
skills.scope: Draw a frequency table; represent data using pictographs and piling.

skills.title: Bar graphs
skills.scope: Represent data using bar graphs; interpret bar graphs.
